#include <iostream>
using namespace std;

bool solve(long long w, long long m);

bool trySolve(long long w, long long m) {
    return m % w == 0 && solve(w, m / w);
}

bool solve(long long w, long long m) {
    if (w <= 3) {
        return true;
    }
    if (m == 1) {
        return true;
    }
    if (m <= 0) {
        return trySolve(w, m - 1) || trySolve(w, m) || trySolve(w, m + 1);
    }
    long long r = m % w;
    if (r == 0) {
        return solve(w, m / w);
    }
    if (r == 1) {
        return solve(w, (m - 1) / w);
    }
    if (r == w - 1) {
        return solve(w, (m + 1) / w);
    }
    return false;
}

int main() {
    ios_base::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(NULL);
    long long w, m;
    cin >> w >> m;
    cout << (solve(w, m) ? "YES" : "NO") << endl;
    return 0;
}
